verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships an official CLI (Snowflake CLI) documented for managing apps/workloads, and runtime probes confirm it installs keylessly via pypi/uvx and supports fully headless, scriptable SQL execution (stdin piping, inline queries, variable substitution) — exactly the kind of interface an AI agent would drive. missing for 10: no independent/third-party hands-on review beyond the vendor probe corroborating agent-friendly usage.
